TIR-IOS-SAST-001.title: Position Independent Executable (PIE) Disabled
TIR-IOS-SAST-001.description: The Mach-O binary header lacks the MH_PIE flag, disabling Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) and making memory corruption exploits deterministic.
TIR-IOS-SAST-001.remediation: Set 'Generate Position-Dependent Executable = NO' (LD_NO_PIE = NO) in Xcode Build Settings.

TIR-IOS-SAST-002.title: Stack Smashing Protection (Canaries) Absent
TIR-IOS-SAST-002.description: The binary does not import ___stack_chk_fail or ___stack_chk_guard, indicating stack buffer overflow guards were omitted during compilation.
TIR-IOS-SAST-002.remediation: Compile all C/C++/Objective-C targets with -fstack-protector-all enabled.

TIR-IOS-SAST-003.title: Automatic Reference Counting (ARC) Disabled
TIR-IOS-SAST-003.description: Missing _objc_release / _swift_release runtime symbols indicate manual memory management, increasing use-after-free and double-free risks.
TIR-IOS-SAST-003.remediation: Enable CLANG_ENABLE_OBJC_ARC = YES in Xcode Build Settings across all application targets.

TIR-IOS-SAST-004.title: Mach-O Binary Unencrypted (cryptid = 0)
TIR-IOS-SAST-004.description: The LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO load command reports cryptid = 0. Expected for development/enterprise IPAs, but App Store builds must have FairPlay DRM active (cryptid = 1).
TIR-IOS-SAST-004.remediation: Verify FairPlay DRM encryption is active on the final App Store Connect build.

TIR-IOS-SAST-005.title: Insecure C String / Memory or Weak PRNG Functions Imported
TIR-IOS-SAST-005.description: The binary imports legacy unbounded C APIs (strcpy, sprintf, gets, memcpy) or predictable PRNGs (rand, random).
TIR-IOS-SAST-005.remediation: Replace unsafe C functions with bounded alternatives (strlcpy, snprintf) and use SecRandomCopyBytes() for cryptographic randomness.

TIR-IOS-SAST-006.title: Weak Cryptographic Algorithms or Cipher Modes Detected
TIR-IOS-SAST-006.description: The binary references broken hashes (MD5, SHA-1), weak ciphers (DES, 3DES, RC4), or deterministic ECB block cipher mode.
TIR-IOS-SAST-006.remediation: Migrate CommonCrypto implementations to Apple CryptoKit using SHA-256/SHA-3 and AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305.

TIR-IOS-SAST-010.title: App Transport Security (ATS) Globally Disabled
TIR-IOS-SAST-010.description: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is set to true in Info.plist, allowing cleartext HTTP traffic and weak TLS configurations across all domains.
TIR-IOS-SAST-010.remediation: Remove NSAllowsArbitraryLoads (or set to false) and enforce HTTPS with TLS 1.2+ across all backend endpoints.

TIR-IOS-SAST-011.title: ATS Disabled for WebViews (NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent)
TIR-IOS-SAST-011.description: NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent is enabled, permitting embedded WKWebView instances to load unencrypted HTTP content.
TIR-IOS-SAST-011.remediation: Set NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent to false and serve all WebView assets over HTTPS.

TIR-IOS-SAST-012.title: Insecure ATS Domain Exception Configured
TIR-IOS-SAST-012.description: An entry in NSExceptionDomains permits insecure HTTP loads, disables Perfect Forward Secrecy, or allows TLS 1.0/1.1.
TIR-IOS-SAST-012.remediation: Upgrade the target server to TLS 1.2+ with PFS cipher suites and remove the NSExceptionDomains entry.

TIR-IOS-SAST-013.title: Custom URL Schemes Exposed (Deep Link Hijacking Surface)
TIR-IOS-SAST-013.description: Custom CFBundleURLSchemes are not uniquely claimed by an app on iOS and can be intercepted by malicious apps registering the same scheme.
TIR-IOS-SAST-013.remediation: Migrate authentication callbacks and sensitive deep links to Universal Links (associated-domains) and strictly sanitize URL parameters.

TIR-IOS-SAST-014.title: Sensitive Device Privacy Permissions Declared
TIR-IOS-SAST-014.description: Info.plist declares privacy usage descriptions granting access to sensitive hardware or user data (Camera, Location, Contacts, Microphone).
TIR-IOS-SAST-014.remediation: Verify that every declared usage description corresponds to an active, user-facing feature.

TIR-IOS-SAST-015.title: Debuggable Entitlement Enabled (get-task-allow = true)
TIR-IOS-SAST-015.description: The embedded provisioning profile/code signature enables get-task-allow, allowing debugger attachment and full sandbox extraction on non-jailbroken devices.
TIR-IOS-SAST-015.remediation: Sign release builds with an App Store or Enterprise Production Distribution profile where get-task-allow is false.

TIR-IOS-SAST-020.title: Hardcoded Cloud Credentials, Private Keys, or Tokens Detected
TIR-IOS-SAST-020.description: Deterministic signature scanning matched hardcoded API keys, private keys, or static bearer tokens inside the Mach-O binary or bundled assets.
TIR-IOS-SAST-020.remediation: Revoke and rotate exposed credentials immediately; issue short-lived tokens dynamically via a backend service and store them in the iOS Keychain.

TIR-IOS-SAST-021.title: High-Entropy String (Potential Embedded Secret)
TIR-IOS-SAST-021.description: Shannon entropy analysis identified an anomalous high-entropy token that may represent an embedded signing key or proprietary secret.
TIR-IOS-SAST-021.remediation: Audit the flagged string and externalize any cryptographic secrets or API tokens from client-side bundle assets.

TIR-IOS-DAST-001.title: Sensitive Data Exposed via Unified Logging / NSLog
TIR-IOS-DAST-001.description: Live syslog monitoring captured tokens, credentials, or PII written to the iOS Unified Logging system during runtime execution.
TIR-IOS-DAST-001.remediation: Remove NSLog/print debug statements in release builds and annotate OSLog dynamic strings with .private privacy qualifiers.

TIR-IOS-DAST-002.title: Plaintext Sensitive Data Stored in Sandbox Container
TIR-IOS-DAST-002.description: Session tokens, passwords, or sensitive PII were written unencrypted to NSUserDefaults (.plist), SQLite, CoreData, or Realm files.
TIR-IOS-DAST-002.remediation: Store credentials and tokens exclusively in the iOS Keychain and apply NSFileProtectionComplete to sensitive sandbox files.

TIR-IOS-DAST-003.title: Sensitive Sandbox Files Not Excluded from Device Backups
TIR-IOS-DAST-003.description: Sensitive local databases or caches lack the NSURLIsExcludedFromBackupKey attribute, exposing data to iCloud and unencrypted iTunes/Finder backups.
TIR-IOS-DAST-003.remediation: Set resourceValues.isExcludedFromBackup = true on sensitive files or store transient caches inside Library/Caches.

TIR-IOS-DAST-004.title: Weak Keychain Item Accessibility Attribute
TIR-IOS-DAST-004.description: Keychain items use permissive accessibility flags (kSecAttrAccessibleAlways or migratable flags without ThisDeviceOnly).

TIR-IOS-DAST-005.title: Sensitive UI Not Obscured Before Background Snapshot
TIR-IOS-DAST-005.description: The application transitions to the background without masking sensitive views, allowing iOS to capture unencrypted screenshots in Library/Caches/Snapshots.
TIR-IOS-DAST-005.remediation: Overlay a privacy splash view or blur effect inside applicationWillResignActive / sceneWillResignActive.

TIR-IOS-DAST-010.title: WKWebView JavaScript Bridge Exposed to Web Content
TIR-IOS-DAST-010.description: WKUserContentController registered a native script message handler callable from JavaScript running inside the WebView.
TIR-IOS-DAST-010.remediation: Validate message.frameInfo.securityOrigin in userContentController(_:didReceive:) and restrict navigation to trusted HTTPS origins.

TIR-IOS-DAST-011.title: WKWebView Local File Access Enabled (allowFileAccessFromFileURLs)
TIR-IOS-DAST-011.description: WKPreferences has allowFileAccessFromFileURLs enabled, allowing local HTML content to read arbitrary sandbox files.
TIR-IOS-DAST-011.remediation: Disable allowFileAccessFromFileURLs on WKPreferences and load local assets via WKURLSchemeHandler.

TIR-IOS-DAST-012.title: Event-Bound Biometric Authentication (LAContext Without Keychain ACL)
TIR-IOS-DAST-012.description: LAContext.evaluatePolicy was called without cryptographic Keychain ACL binding, relying solely on a boolean callback that can be hooked at runtime.
TIR-IOS-DAST-012.remediation: Protect an authentication secret in the Keychain with SecAccessControlCreateWithFlags(..., .biometryCurrentSet, ...) so biometric unlock releases cryptographic material.

TIR-IOS-DAST-013.title: Unrestricted Write to Global General Pasteboard
TIR-IOS-DAST-013.description: Data was copied to UIPasteboard.general without expiration or localOnly constraints, making it readable by other apps and Universal Clipboard.
TIR-IOS-DAST-013.remediation: Use UIPasteboard.general.setItems(_:options:) with .localOnly and .expirationDate for sensitive fields.

TIR-IOS-DAST-020.title: Missing or Bypassable TLS Certificate Pinning
TIR-IOS-DAST-020.description: The application accepted a user-installed proxy root CA certificate without enforcing SPKI public-key or certificate pinning.
TIR-IOS-DAST-020.remediation: Implement SPKI public-key pinning via URLSessionDelegate (urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:)) or NSPinnedDomains in Info.plist.

TIR-IOS-DAST-021.title: Sensitive Credentials or PII Transmitted in URL Query Parameters
TIR-IOS-DAST-021.description: Intercepted HTTPS requests revealed session tokens, API keys, or PII passed inside URL query strings where they are logged by proxies and web servers.
TIR-IOS-DAST-021.remediation: Transmit authentication tokens in HTTP Authorization headers and sensitive parameters inside encrypted POST request bodies.

TIR-IOS-DAST-030.title: Lack of Jailbreak Environment Detection
TIR-IOS-DAST-030.description: The application executed normally on a jailbroken device without detecting sandbox escapes, unauthorized dyld injections, or suspicious filesystem paths.
TIR-IOS-DAST-030.remediation: Implement multi-layered runtime environment integrity checks combined with backend App Attest (DCAppAttestService) validation.

TIR-IOS-DAST-031.title: Lack of Anti-Debugging / Debugger Attachment Detection
TIR-IOS-DAST-031.description: The process allowed dynamic debugger/instrumentation attachment without detecting P_TRACED flags via sysctl or ptrace protections.
TIR-IOS-DAST-031.remediation: Add sysctl P_TRACED checks and Apple App Attest assertions for high-risk transactions.
